name: Floor Burnisher
definition: A commercial floor-treatment machine that drives a manufacturer-approved burnishing pad at high or ultra-high rotational speed to restore or maintain gloss on compatible finished hard floors.
includedScope: Ride-on burnishers represented by reviewed commercial ranges
Passive or active dust-control configurations where documented
excludedScope: Stone grinding or crystallization unless expressly approved
Propane, autonomous or hazardous-area machines not represented by the reviewed evidence
primaryApplications: Gloss maintenance on compatible finished resilient floors
Large public-building and retail floor routes
headline: Floor burnisher speed, pad pressure, dust control and buyer verification
description: This profile explains corded, battery and ride-on burnisher formats while separating pad speed, pressure, dust control, achieved gloss and floor-finish compatibility.
metaDescription: Commercial floor burnisher guide covering UHS types, pad speed, pressure, dust control, models and procurement checks.
disclaimer: This is an independent category reference, not model-specific operating, floor-finish, indoor-air or safety advice. Confirm the current manual, pad, finish, dust-control configuration, electrical system and local requirements before use or procurement.

keyFacts.label: Primary treatment
keyFacts.value: High-speed pad action maintains gloss on compatible finished hard floors
keyFacts.evidence: Reviewed manufacturers position the named machines for polishing or burnishing finished floors.
keyFacts.scope: Exact pad and floor-finish combinations approved by the relevant suppliers.

keyFacts.label: Reviewed pad speeds
keyFacts.value: 1200–2100 rpm across the selected representative models
keyFacts.evidence: Official sources publish 1200, 1500, 1600 and 2100 rpm for named machines.
keyFacts.scope: Selected models only; not a category performance ranking.

keyFacts.label: Dust-control boundary
keyFacts.value: Passive bags, active vacuum and HEPA configurations are not equivalent
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturer sources identify distinct passive and active filtration systems on named models.
keyFacts.scope: Exact quoted configuration; no universal whole-machine capture claim.

systemFlow.name: Power supply
systemFlow.role: Supplies the pad motor, traction and dust control fitted to the machine.
systemFlow.evidence: Official documentation distinguishes corded and battery configurations.

systemFlow.name: Pad drive
systemFlow.componentFamily: Motor, belt or direct drive and pad driver
systemFlow.role: Rotates the approved pad at the stated model speed.
systemFlow.evidence: Official product data identifies belt-driven and model-specific pad-drive systems.

systemFlow.name: Floor contact
systemFlow.role: Maintains controlled pad contact with the compatible finish.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturers publish head sizes and fixed, adjustable or controlled pressure arrangements.
systemFlow.scope: Named configurations; pressure reporting boundaries differ.

systemFlow.name: Dust management
systemFlow.role: Contains and collects burnishing dust where the selected system is fitted.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources describe passive collection or active HEPA filtration on named machines.
systemFlow.scope: No combustible- or hazardous-dust approval is implied.

variants.name: Corded walk-behind burnisher
variants.taskScale: Defined rooms and routes with accessible power
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator guides a straight-line or assisted machine
variants.spaceConstraints: Cord route, outlet location and turning clearance
variants.limitations: Cord management and circuit availability constrain achieved output.
variants.evidence: Nilfisk, Kärcher, TASKI and Columbus publish corded high-speed models.

variants.name: Battery walk-behind burnisher
variants.taskScale: Larger routes or sites where cords impede operation
variants.operatorRelationship: Pad-assist or self-propelled operation depending on model
variants.spaceConstraints: Battery mass, charging and storage requirements
variants.limitations: Runtime varies with battery, pressure, floor and duty cycle.
variants.evidence: Tennant publishes B5 and B7 battery walk-behind configurations and model data.
variants.scope: Named North American and documented configurations.

variants.name: Ride-on burnisher
variants.spaceConstraints: Door, aisle, turn, ramp, lift and storage envelope
variants.limitations: Large nominal output may not transfer to fragmented routes.
variants.evidence: Tennant identifies B10 as a battery rider burnisher and publishes model specifications.

performanceMetrics.name: Pad speed
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: One input to the finish-pad-machine process
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Maximum or nominal no-load rpm by model
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Rpm alone does not establish gloss, heat, finish compatibility or productivity.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official sources publish model-specific pad rpm.

performanceMetrics.name: Head or pad size
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Defines nominal treatment width and consumable size
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Head, driver and pad dimensions may differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Equal diameter does not prove the same mounting or approved pad.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers publish 500–690 mm class head or working widths for selected models.

performanceMetrics.name: Pad pressure or downforce
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Affects contact and should be matched to the finish process
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Fixed, variable or proprietary settings use different units and methods
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare labels such as low, medium and high as normalized force.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Tennant and other sources describe model-specific pressure arrangements.

performanceMetrics.name: Productivity and runtime
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Theoretical or maximum manufacturer value under stated configuration
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Turns, pad changes, charging, cord moves and finish condition reduce achieved output.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official product data publishes maximum productivity or runtime for selected models.

performanceMetrics.name: Sound and filtration
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Inputs to occupied-area and dust-control assessment
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Sound test method and filtration configuration must be matched
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A filter efficiency statement is not whole-machine dust capture.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Tennant publishes configuration-specific sound and filtration data for B5/B7.
performanceMetrics.scope: Named active or passive dust-control configurations.

applicationFit.application: Retail, education and public-building gloss maintenance
applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers position reviewed burnishers for commercial and institutional finished floors.
applicationFit.scope: Compatible floor finishes and approved pads only.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Occupied-area planning must combine sound, cord or traffic separation, dust control and finish cure state.
applicationFit.assessment: A representative trial should record appearance, dust and pad consumption over a full route.
applicationFit.basis: Official applications and machine configuration data.
applicationFit.limitations: No universal suitability during occupancy is established.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Define the finish system and operating window, then run a controlled route trial.

applicationFit.evidence: Battery walk-behind and rider models are officially positioned for higher-productivity burnishing.
applicationFit.scope: Named Tennant configurations and open routes compatible with their envelopes.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Route geometry and charging can outweigh nominal productivity.
applicationFit.assessment: Compare achieved square metres per paid hour including transport, pad service and charging.
applicationFit.basis: Official maximum performance and format data.
applicationFit.limitations: WCB has not independently timed the models.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Run a full-shift simulation using the quoted battery and charger.

applicationFit.evidence: Selected machines provide passive collection or active HEPA-filtered dust control.
applicationFit.scope: Exact dust-control option, bag, filter and seal condition.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Specify the complete airflow path, not only the filter-media label.
applicationFit.assessment: Inspect skirt contact, bag installation, seals and filter maintenance during the trial.
applicationFit.limitations: No hazardous-dust or site air-quality compliance conclusion is established.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Obtain configuration-specific documentation and define a dust acceptance check.

componentStack.name: Pad driver and pad
componentStack.role: Transfers rotary action to the floor finish.
variants: Burnishing pads by finish and speed
Specialty pads approved by the supplier
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturer sources identify machine-specific head sizes and pad systems.
componentStack.scope: Family labels do not establish cross-model compatibility.

componentStack.name: Pressure and head-control system
componentStack.role: Maintains the intended pad contact as the machine moves.
componentStack.evidence: Official documentation describes distinct pressure systems.

componentStack.name: Dust skirt, bag and filter
componentStack.role: Contains and collects airborne residue generated during burnishing.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish passive and active arrangements.
componentStack.scope: No cross-model filter fit or hazardous-dust suitability is implied.

componentStack.name: Battery and charger or cord set
componentStack.role: Supplies propulsion, pad drive and dust control.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources publish model-specific power packages.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Achieved result with exact finish, pad, pressure and passes
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources publish speed and configuration but not a normalized cross-brand gloss test.
procurementDecisions.scope: Named models and the buyer's actual finish system.
procurementDecisions.assessment: Define the appearance target and measure a controlled site trial.
procurementDecisions.basis: Gloss is produced by a complete process rather than a single specification.
procurementDecisions.limitations: WCB has not independently measured gloss.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Require the supplier to document pad, finish cure time, pressure, passes and measured outcome.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm pad speed rating, driver, head pressure and finish-manufacturer approval.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Dust, sound, traffic separation and power route
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Treating HEPA media efficiency as whole-machine control
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manufacturers document distinct sound and filtration configurations.
procurementDecisions.scope: Exact quoted machine, option and operating condition.
procurementDecisions.assessment: Evaluate the complete machine and work zone under representative conditions.
procurementDecisions.basis: Media efficiency, skirt seal, airflow and operator practice are separate variables.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No site air-quality compliance conclusion is made.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Specify the dust-control option and inspect performance during a supervised trial.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Record bag/filter part numbers, skirt condition, sound boundary and exclusion zone.

procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Using maximum runtime without the quoted battery and pressure setting
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources publish battery options, runtime or productivity within model boundaries.
procurementDecisions.scope: Named battery models and quoted charger.
procurementDecisions.assessment: A route model should include transit, pad service and battery recovery.
procurementDecisions.basis: Runtime varies with pack, floor and load.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No universal shift coverage is established.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Run a duty-cycle trial with the exact battery and charger.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm chemistry, amp-hours, charger input, ventilation and replacement availability.

engineeringChecks.reason: Speed, pressure and pad chemistry can affect coating appearance and service life.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Obtain written approval from the finish and equipment suppliers for the complete process.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official sources limit use to approved pads and floor-treatment tasks.

engineeringChecks.reason: Passive, active and HEPA-labeled arrangements have different airflow paths and maintenance.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Specify every skirt, bag, filter and vacuum option by part number.

engineeringChecks.reason: Corded models need controlled cable routes; battery models need compatible charging.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Map outlets or charging provision and verify the exact regional electrical package.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official specifications publish power-source and configuration data.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-67:2021
standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements for powered floor treatment machines intended for commercial indoor or outdoor use.
standards.evidence: IEC lists the valid fifth edition and its commercial floor-treatment scope.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and the exact machine classification.

developments.title: IEC commercial floor-treatment safety edition published
developments.summary: IEC published edition 5.0 of IEC 60335-2-67 covering commercial floor treatment machines.
developments.evidence: The IEC catalogue records the edition and publication date.
developments.scope: International base standard; regional implementation differs.
